title: VTA Calendar — Feeds — List — payload
description: A client lists the principal's calendar feeds it has standing to see, with when each was last read and how often — never an address. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

includeRevoked.description: Also revoked and expired feeds. Absent: live ones only.

cursor.description: An opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, for the same caller and filters; the VTA refuses one it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 100; the VTA chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTA Calendar — Feeds — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/calendar/feeds/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/calendar/feeds/list/0.1#response.

items.description: The feeds, newest first, never with an address.

nextCursor.description: Present when more items remain; absent on the last page.
